usages.explain: Used to ask how to say a word or a sentence in a particular language. The word/sentence being asked about is usually enclosed in quotation marks 「」.

examples.content: 「すみません」は英語で何ですか。
examples.transcription: 「すみません」はえいごでなにですか。
examples.mean: What does "excuse me" mean in English?

examples.content: 「Gia đình」 は日本語で何ですか。
examples.transcription: 「Gia đình」 はにほんごでなんですか。
examples.mean: What does "Gia đình" mean in Japanese?

title: は..語で何ですか => What does it mean...
